Concrete hits [6,7,8,9,10,11,12] are therefore intentionally left to the C8 rewrite rather than rewritten independently.; C3: No profitable S1 signature lift is planned because the function is `pub unsafe` and changing raw-pointer parameters to references/slices would require cross-function caller proof for a public API. S2 local-hoist also has little leverage here: the reported loads are the per-byte input loads and table accesses inherent to the CRC recurrence, not repeated invariant field loads.
